basis: User reports prior laptop overheating/freezes; CPU-package readings reveal heat not represented by the existing GPU-only guard.

external_editor_indexer.ownership: Outside this research unit; unchanged. CPU percentage is the process lifetime average, not an instantaneous measurement.

followup_observation.interpretation: A subsequent reading is lower; this does not establish a sustained thermal limit or isolate the indexer's effect.

cost_consequence: The earlier rolling forecast assumes 190% CPU and is now historical. No measured remaining-phase forecast exists at the lower quota. Full-panel completion remains at risk; no cap extension or additional fit admission.
monitoring_limit: The running guard reads GPU temperature and host memory/PSI. Root and delivery actor also inspect CPU-package temperature; the frozen worker code is not rewritten.
